description: This file defines an abstract test case class for PHPUnit, extending the base PHPUnit TestCase and adding utility methods for reflection-based access to private/protected methods and entity references. It is part of the testing utilities in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: An abstract class extending PHPUnit's TestCase with additional utilities for reflection-based testing and entity management in the OrangeHRM testing framework.

methods.name: getEntityReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to an entity object given its class name and identifier, using the entity manager trait.

methods.name: getClassMethod
methods.description: Uses reflection to access a class method (private or protected) and make it accessible.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethod
methods.description: Invokes a private method of a class via reflection, creating an instance with specified constructor parameters.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a private method on a mock object via reflection.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethod
methods.description: Invokes a protected method through reflection by calling the private method invoker.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a protected method on a mock object via reflection.
